questions.legend: How much of your household income depends on your current employment?
What observable changes are happening at work?
What would a forced role change disrupt most?
questions.help: Choose the practical area that would matter most—not a clinical assessment.

questions.legend: If this income stopped, how long before a major household decision would be forced?
What would you most like more control over?
Which future are you willing to investigate with evidence?
When would evidence need to be useful for this decision?

executive_leader.cta: Request My Executive Ownership Strategy Review
executive_leader.interpretation: Your executive background may bring decision discipline and leadership range, while ownership asks you to test how close you want to be to daily execution.
criteria: Which executive strengths transfer to an owner-operator role?
What decision rights must ownership add?
Which models fit your capital, leadership span, and operating involvement?
executive_leader.contradiction: Test this: senior leadership experience does not automatically mean a semi-absentee model is the better fit.

skilled_trades_operator.interpretation: Your operating experience may create practical credibility, but the owner role can shift from doing the work to building the system and leading people.
criteria: Which field skills create an advantage without trapping you in production?
How much hiring, sales, and people leadership does the model require?
What operating territory and demand assumptions need proof?
skilled_trades_operator.contradiction: Test this: being excellent at the work is not the same as wanting the owner's job.

portfolio_investor.cta: Request My Manager-Led Franchise Diligence Review
portfolio_investor.interpretation: Your portfolio perspective may support comparative diligence, while a manager-led franchise still requires active governance and operating accountability.
criteria: What manager economics are supported after full labor costs?
Which controls let you govern without pretending the asset is passive?
How concentrated would capital, territory, and franchisor exposure become?
portfolio_investor.contradiction: Test this: manager-led does not mean passive, and diversification can create a new concentration.

first_time_owner.cta: Request My First Ownership Model Review
first_time_owner.interpretation: As a first-time owner, your most useful first comparison is not brand versus brand; it is the owner role and tradeoffs across starting, buying, and franchising.
criteria: Which owner role fits your strengths and non-negotiables?
What support are you actually paying for in each path?
What capital, runway, and household boundaries must the model respect?
first_time_owner.contradiction: Test this: more support does not remove owner responsibility or make a model suitable.

second_act_flexible_role.cta: Request My Second-Act Ownership Design Review
second_act_flexible_role.interpretation: Your next act may need to fit the life you have built, so role design matters as much as category appeal or projected economics.
criteria: What weekly role and schedule are genuinely acceptable?
Which responsibilities do you want to keep, delegate, or avoid?
How must the path fit family, location, capital, and legacy goals?
second_act_flexible_role.contradiction: Test this: a flexible goal does not make a business flexible during launch or staffing pressure.

general_or_unknown.interpretation: Your background is not yet specific enough for a responsible role-fit conclusion. The next useful move is a neutral sequence that defines what must change before narrowing options.
criteria: What must change from the current state?
Which owner role and constraints need definition?
What evidence would support proceed, more investigation, not yet, or no?
general_or_unknown.contradiction: Test this: interest in control is not evidence that franchise ownership is the right vehicle.

e2_business_intent.cta: Request My E-2 Franchise Business-Fit Review
e2_business_intent.boundary: Business-fit only: OFA does not provide immigration or legal advice, determine visa eligibility, or promise an immigration outcome.
e2_business_intent.interpretation: Your volunteered E-2 business intent makes capitalization, active direction, operating role, and business evidence important fit questions alongside ordinary ownership diligence.
criteria: Does the business role fit how you expect to direct and develop the enterprise?
Are capitalization and operating assumptions supportable with independent advice?
Which franchise constraints affect the business case and your intended role?
e2_business_intent.contradiction: Test this: a business that appears franchise-ready is not automatically suitable for your goals or sufficient for an E-2 case.
